systems.system: National ID card registration by mobile registration team
systems.platform: laptops, photo printer and biometric iris and fingerprint scanners, run on generators
systems.owner: Department of Civil Registry, Nationality, Passports and Immigration (DCRNPI), with UNHCR
systems.tiers: mobile drive in Raja, Western Bahr el Ghazal, May 2022; earlier drives in Wau; some 15,000 people served since 2013

note: A mobile national-ID registration drive (identity class); a birth certificate or age assessment is named only as a document an applicant must produce. Nothing on how births or deaths are registered.
